v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: Time slots are provided in 24 hour format (HH:mm)
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_3: Lunch break blocks meeting starts from 12:00-13:00
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_4: Suggested start time occur only at 15-min intervals
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_5: Events outside working hours do not affect availability
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_6: Fridays: meeting must not start v2_human 15:00

v2_human_g3_exception: Friday: meeting start times must not be later than 15:00. Lunch: Meeting may not start during 12:00-17:00

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: System shall accept a list of events
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: accept a desired meeting duration in min
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: Compute and return all valid meeting start times
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_4: accept a date string for the day
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_5: NOT suggest any start time that overlaps on a prior event
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_6: Ignore events completely outside of working hours

v2_human_g3_goal: Suggest all valid meeting start time for a given day based on existing calendar events and a desired meeting duration. Returned start times must fall within working hours
v2_human_g3_input: Events (List[Card[str,str]]) - meeting duration (int) start-HH:mm end-HH:mm day (str)

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: Must not return any start time during lunch
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: Must not return any start time v2_human 15:00 on Fridays

v2_human_g3_output: Returns a sorted list of HH:mm showing all valid meeting start times
v2_human_g3_tb: System returns all feasible start times rather than choosing a single best slot time

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_1: All Friday v1_human start time are >= 15:00
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: Returned list is in ascending order
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_3: Every start time is within working hours
